scope: Three live configured-model samples with backend state verification. Separate from rules-mode browser checks.

cases.question: Show monthly sales value for 2017
cases.reply:
**Sales value (BRL)** rose (+549.4%) from BRL 111,798.36 (Jan 2017) to **BRL 726,033.19** (Dec 2017), by month. Peak: BRL 987,765.37 (Nov 2017); low: BRL 111,798.36 (Jan 2017).
_Dataset: Olist Brazilian E-Commerce / real imported data / BRL. Dates group orders by purchase date. Review/delivery relationships are associations, not proven causes._
